question: Can a factorized trainable history-conditioned action-effect learner generalize under an unseen smooth oscillatory nuisance frequency better than equally pretrained conventional MLP/GRU and source-independent per-episode fitted polynomial ridge with exactly the same observed action-outcome histories?

authored_source.query_actual_action: Bernoulli +-1 iid; train on executed query only
authored_source.scorer_counterfactual: both alternatives evaluated ONLY after fitting, not visible to training models

models.candidate: FactorizedHistoryMLP flatten eight [time,real action,observed outcome] -> 32 GELU -> 24 GELU -> separate scalar drift and action-effect heads, output drift+beta_hat*query_action
models.conventional_mlp: same history+query_action -> 32 GELU -> 24 GELU -> scalar prediction
models.conventional_gru: GRU(3,18) on 8 factual steps + query scalar -> 24 GELU -> scalar prediction
models.wrong_credit: exact candidate architecture, per-episode roll past executed action sequence by one while leaving factual observed outcomes and query actual actions intact
models.polynomial_ridge: fit per-episode [1,time,time²,actual_action] against identical 8 past factual outcomes, predict both query actions; conventional no-neural training and separately timed
models.last_effect: use latest actual normalized factual outcome/action, no drift correction; no fitting
models.capacity: record counts, candidate and conventional within 20% relative parameter counts or mark mismatch; independent total FLOPs/cost UNVERIFIED
models.independent_wrong_credit_shuffle: deterministic one-position roll within each history only; no RNG consumed

metrics_and_thresholds.primary_ood_mse: candidate <=0.90 * min(fully-trained MLP,fully-trained GRU,polynomial_ridge), independently for all 3 model seeds
metrics_and_thresholds.causal_effect_mae: candidate < each separately trained MLP and GRU inferred from read-only +-query previews, all 3 seeds
metrics_and_thresholds.wrong_credit_negative: candidate OOD MSE <=0.80 * wrong_credit OOD MSE independently for all 3 model seeds
metrics_and_thresholds.other: report validation MSE, per-goal optimal actual action fraction, conditional effect MAE, train+inference wall-clock, exact factual source hashes and model seed, parity of training sample indices, complete nulls
metrics_and_thresholds.trained_baseline_competence: report last-five recorded validation MSE, plateau relative change <1%; otherwise COMPETENCE_UNVERIFIED, cannot claim science
metrics_and_thresholds.science_pass: NOT_POSSIBLE_IN_AUTHORED_DEV; separately owner-qualified untouched sources and full regression required
metrics_and_thresholds.source_interventions: No original external science first use, no protected seeds/checkpoints, no model promotion, no FORGE research activation.
